text_lines: コステロ エントリー可能に
起用・出場時間は未定

evidence: 11月10日19時05分から、千葉ジェッツと大阪エヴェッサが対戦します。
マット・コステロ選手は、同じ日にインジュアリーリストから抹消されました。11月10日の大阪戦から、試合にエントリーできます。
【予測】千葉Jが優位、焦点はインサイドの攻防
コステロ選手が戻れば、インサイドの人数は補えます。出場時間は未定で、実際の起用は試合まで分かりません。

brief.prompt:
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape approximately 16:9, ideally 1792x1024 or 1920x1080, at least 1000 pixels wide. This is a new original drawn illustration for バスケまとめ, a pregame preview dated 2026-11-10. Return only one composed image.

ART DIRECTION: approved editorial style: almost-black charcoal #151A18 background, bold vivid lime #CCF43B sweeping dry-brush ink strokes and sparse ink spatter, warm white enormous heavy Japanese sans-serif headlines. Hand-painted black-and-white ink/crosshatching athlete with controlled red accents on a plain jersey and orange basketball. A strong graphic poster with few elements, readable thumbnail hierarchy, no photorealism, no photographic texture or collage. Typography is clean, heavyweight and carefully typeset; illustration uses expressive brush linework. Left approximately 57 percent is text, right approximately 43 percent is the player. Keep text away from face/hands/ball. 5% safe margins.

SUBJECT: exactly one real athlete, Matt Costello / マット・コステロ, the article's central returning player. Appearance has been visually checked against the Chiba Jets official roster portrait at https://chibajets.jp/team/players/detail/id=26996?PlayerID=51000642 and its portrait https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026111006/files/user/roster/704/2026-27/51000642_01.jpg . Draw his recognizable features: very tall, strong broad-shouldered adult man, light skin, short medium-brown hair close-cropped at sides and slightly wavy on top with a slightly high squared hairline, blue-gray eyes, straight prominent nose, broad angular face, full neatly trimmed brown beard and connected mustache. Keep the eye/nose/beard shapes legible in the ink illustration and do not darken away the face. No headband. Plain red basketball sleeveless jersey with white trim, no number or lettering, no logos or sponsor marks. Strong but believable basketball build. Do not depict any other players, anonymous silhouettes, or invented people.

ACTION / COMPOSITION: dynamic three-quarter view of Costello securing an orange basketball firmly with both hands around upper chest/shoulder level after a rebound, torso twisting slightly while looking upcourt toward the left. Bent knees/athletic pivot stance implied; crop naturally at thighs near the lower edge. Face, hair, forearms, elbows and entire basketball fully within canvas. Both hands anatomically convincing, fingers naturally wrapping around opposite sides of the ball, no duplicated limbs or floating ball. His expression is focused. Use diagonally rising lime brush strokes behind his figure for energy. This is an imaginative general basketball play illustration, never a reconstruction of this game's actual event and never proof that he played.

EXACT TEXT, in Japanese. Spell all text correctly; do not add any text other than the following:
Small top-left brand: 「バスケまとめ」
Compact top-left date/kicker: 「2026.11.10　試合前予測」
Large white matchup: 「千葉J vs 大阪」
Largest lime headline on two balanced lines: 「インサイドの」 / 「攻防」
Below headline, medium white: 「コステロ エントリー可能に」
Directly below that, clearly readable smaller white qualifier: 「起用・出場時間は未定」
Bottom-left clear disclosure: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

The text refers solely to the supplied frozen article: Chiba Jets versus Osaka Evessa pregame preview; Costello can be entered from November 10, but his actual use and minutes are not known. Do not imply a played game, definite appearance, final score, victory, comeback performance, or decisive shot. No scores, statistics, injury claims, or player achievements. Do not use any names or numbers from earlier style-reference examples. Do not include official team/league logos, sponsor text, official photos, watermarks or ornamental fake writing. The result must unmistakably be an illustration. Ensure the two disclosure labels remain visible.
